translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from source extraction and all twenty PDF page images. No prior English translation or translation service used. Edition glossary and primary dictionaries consulted; interpretation and uncertainties recorded per source ID. No independent specialist review.

notes.manas-2010:p0767:b001:l013: Бил: elephant, not waist; дилде gold coins, no modern denomination assigned.
notes.manas-2010:p0767:b001:l014: The thousand palace girls and their seizure as booty are explicit in Bakay's speech.
notes.manas-2010:p0767:b001:l021: Бет каратып: literally turning faces toward oneself, implying enforced submission.
notes.manas-2010:p0767:b001:l024: The paired land/people destruction injunctions are retained without softening.
notes.manas-2010:p0767:b001:l033: Shooruk is called Chinese here; other ethnic descriptions are not harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p0767:b001:l041: Narration shifts to Shooruk's attack on the Noygut, made explicit on the next page.
notes.manas-2010:p0768:b001:l016: Айча бел retained literally as crescent-waisted; the exact beauty convention remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0768:b001:l020: The preceding verse remains unresolved; this clause is translated separately without supplying its missing object.
notes.manas-2010:p0768:b001:l026: Напси: appetite/desire seizing Bakay; narrator's explicit comment retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0768:b001:l029: Кожосан: protecting spirit, edition glossary1839:l019. Applied as Bakay's epithet, not an ordinary military rank.
notes.manas-2010:p0768:b001:l036: Мураа: faithful companion, following Yudakhin's epic sense checked in earlier batches; not inheritance.
notes.manas-2010:p0769:b001:l004: Eight khans explicit; no historical total inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0769:b001:l010: Эки экен деп койбогон interpreted as never requiring a repeated instruction; elliptical wording noted.
notes.manas-2010:p0769:b001:l038: Opening horses' eyes by racing is retained literally; precise training idiom unverified.
notes.manas-2010:p0770:b001:l007: Kayypchy/Kangkung shrine/Khotan retained as named geography; exact locations unverified.
notes.manas-2010:p0770:b001:l010: Тоороктууда may be descriptive among poplars or the place-name Tooroktuu; descriptive reading selected. Чынар identified as plane tree.
notes.manas-2010:p0770:b001:l012: Кара мунар read as dark haze over the campsite; not a confidently identified tower or place name.
notes.manas-2010:p0770:b001:l016: Кол read as troops, not hands, in moving into camp; syntax remains compressed.
notes.manas-2010:p0770:b001:l019: Жанказан rendered traveling cauldron; precise portable construction unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p0770:b001:l023: The blood-stained lord is Manas, followed by Bakay; punctuation separates them, yielding four persons with Ajybay and Kyrgyl below.
notes.manas-2010:p0770:b001:l035: Жая and жал are horse-rump meat and neck fat; horsemeat feast context.
notes.manas-2010:p0770:b001:l037: Казы: fatty rib portion, not an assumed sausage preparation; май fat retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0771:b001:l001: Кулач is an armspan/fathom, not converted into a precise metric length.
notes.manas-2010:p0771:b001:l010: The shrine and surviving signs are the narrator's assertions, not independent archaeological verification.
notes.manas-2010:p0771:b001:l013: Зың-зың is an imitative buzzing/ringing sound; exact activity unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p0771:b001:l016: Бучкак: trouser hem/leg; literal image conveys disregard for danger.
notes.manas-2010:p0771:b001:l018: Кутпа жак: north, following source glossary/shared lexical research.
notes.manas-2010:p0771:b001:l028: Таңашып provisionally facing the dawn breeze; precise movement uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0772:b001:l009: Көмөкөй throat retained as the source's anatomical exaggeration for removing bits.
notes.manas-2010:p0772:b001:l012: Fox-whisker is a translated vernacular grass name, without species identification; жоңкучка alfalfa.
notes.manas-2010:p0772:b001:l020: Таз карын retained as bare belly; possible idiomatic nuance uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0772:b001:l025: Түпкүч: circular cauldron support. Yudakhin gives the exact bending comparison; circular shape noted rather than three-legged tripod.
notes.manas-2010:p0772:b001:l031: Чалгын here flight feathers in the following wing metaphor, rather than twelve scouts; forty tails rendered tail feathers.
notes.manas-2010:p0773:b001:l002: Жетиген: Seven Stars, the Great Bear/Big Dipper grouping; no precise sky orientation inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0773:b001:l004: Кыбыла retained as direction of prayer; no modern compass bearing imposed.
notes.manas-2010:p0773:b001:l007: Кутпа north, distinct from кыбыла in the preceding rows.
notes.manas-2010:p0773:b001:l017: Кыялы кымбат бекери is elliptical; noble spirits beyond price provisional. No replacement of printed бекери is made.
notes.manas-2010:p0773:b001:l027: Кундуз rendered otter; exact historical fur species is not established by this passage alone.
notes.manas-2010:p0773:b001:l030: Багалак here trouser leg, not the knucklebone-game implement homonym.
notes.manas-2010:p0773:b001:l034: Жети сан retained as seven great hosts, without inventing a decimal total.
notes.manas-2010:p0773:b001:l035: Желбегей: robes thrown loose, retaining the casual-dress image in the attack.
notes.manas-2010:p0774:b001:l006: Чети менен interpreted from the flank/edge; implicit directing subject provisionally Bakay.
notes.manas-2010:p0774:b001:l025: Сөлөкөтү сөгүлүп translated literally as figures unfolding; precise visual nuance uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0774:b001:l032: The companions struggle with the horses' mouths through their reins, not human biting.
notes.manas-2010:p0774:b001:l038: Даңкан clods, with cauldron-size and spark-striking imagery retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0774:b001:l042: Түпкүч circular pot support; the horse neck bends in an arc.
notes.manas-2010:p0775:b001:l008: Karabayyr retained as a horse type name, not an unidentified common noun.
notes.manas-2010:p0775:b001:l017: Printed Астыңкы кол канжыга is elliptical. Forward arm/saddle-strap relationship is provisional; no omitted invented verb.
notes.manas-2010:p0775:b001:l018: Күрөөкө is an expensive outer garment/protective coat, not necessarily metal mail; edition1839:l041–042 and Manas encyclopedia/2015 dictionary. Кары бою length remains a qualified literal arm-length reading.
notes.manas-2010:p0775:b001:l024: Kötörmö and Chatkal are retained as place names, without exact modern mapping.
notes.manas-2010:p0775:b001:l027: Өң read as other warriors in context; possible clipped/variant form, raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0775:b001:l039: Blue ticks are the source's literal comparison, suggesting close clinging/numbers; not silently made eagles.
notes.manas-2010:p0776:b001:l004: The absence of carved pattern on the painted spear is retained as printed.
notes.manas-2010:p0776:b001:l011: Анткор: deceitful/pretending, contrasting with bravery; the unfavorable epithet is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0776:b001:l015: Ninety thousand explicit and retained as epic hyperbole.
notes.manas-2010:p0776:b001:l034: Бозо rendered grain beer; source drunken misconduct is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0776:b001:l035: Кожо rendered holy man; beating and wailing explicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0776:b001:l041: Аңкоо foolish/naive, even in fearlessness; not normalized to heroic praise.
notes.manas-2010:p0777:b001:l005: Printed separate display row кырк жинди retained as its own translation row, although it continues the preceding sentence.
notes.manas-2010:p0777:b001:l019: Cap-to-head escalation explicit; the butcher epithet is retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0777:b001:l021: Water-to-poison escalation explicit; no reversal to make it prudent.
notes.manas-2010:p0778:b001:l004: Арыптап provisionally carefully in storing ammunition; exact adverbial nuance uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0778:b001:l008: Кызыр rendered Khizir, the blessing figure; not a military scout.
notes.manas-2010:p0778:b001:l020: Chewing Alöökö in fangs is the narrator's metaphor, not an invented physical event.
notes.manas-2010:p0778:b001:l033: Turning a lasso pole retained literally, implying resistance; exact conventional idiom unverified.
notes.manas-2010:p0778:b001:l042: Санат in this intimidation context rendered lesson; not an inventory count.
notes.manas-2010:p0779:b001:l008: Printed алты алган literally taken six, without an expressed object; possible textual defect. Six retained with uncertainty rather than silently replaced by алып алган.
notes.manas-2010:p0779:b001:l017: Тагы read as thrones/seats of rule; no emendation to another destroyed item.
notes.manas-2010:p0779:b001:l035: Шамыян is a peg through an ox yoke: edition1843:l041 and1969/2015 dictionary with Manas farming example. Corrected from an unsupported canopy reading.
notes.manas-2010:p0779:b001:l040: Алайда provisionally Alay place name; alternatively a discourse form thus/there. Raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0780:b001:l020: Black mourning headdress is the literal humiliation/bereavement image; no woman's death supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0780:b001:l024: Ойронун read as his devastating champion, potentially Shooruk himself; referent not silently resolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0780:b001:l034: Бил: elephant, confirmed by the animal comparison; not bodily strength alone.
notes.manas-2010:p0780:b001:l039: Women as abundant captive booty is explicit in the speech; not changed into consensual courtship.
notes.manas-2010:p0781:b001:l014: Printed Багынып калсак Шоорукка means if we submit to Shooruk. Retained despite following demand to convert him; no silent reversal of subject/object.
notes.manas-2010:p0781:b001:l017: Dark faith/clean imagery and subsequent forced conversion threats are the speaker's language; retained without endorsement.
notes.manas-2010:p0781:b001:l029: Жаның чыккан retains life departing as a hostile epithet; not proof Shooruk has already died.
notes.manas-2010:p0781:b001:l039: Жаке is deferential address; кулдук submission. Master, I submit preserves the relationship without a guessed personal name.
notes.manas-2010:p0782:b001:l018: Акыйнак: mocking taunts, supported by2015 dictionary citing Karalaev Manas; not counsel or admonition.
notes.manas-2010:p0782:b001:l020: Койдой sheep comparison retained; exact humiliation idiom remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0782:b001:l027: Жүлгүп provisionally working out/pursuing a line of reasoning; exact verbal nuance uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0783:b001:l001: Чоро/jоро wordplay rendered retainers/friends; the companionship contrast is explicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0783:b001:l003: Аты name/renown belongs to Manas although companions do the spearing; source attribution retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0783:b001:l009: Twins of the same age is a figurative collective comparison, not asserted genealogy.
notes.manas-2010:p0783:b001:l017: Gold-collared, bullet-impenetrable clothing is elliptical in the source; no named armor inserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0783:b001:l023: Five-by-five grouping retained with the elliptical however-many construction.
notes.manas-2010:p0783:b001:l035: Капчал: rocky gorge, Yudakhin/2015. Мунар also means tower but haze selected with the landscape/ridge image. The red gorge wrapped in haze remains provisional, not a settled place name.
notes.manas-2010:p0783:b001:l036: Бел ridge/back/support metaphor retained literally; precise connection to prior row uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0784:b001:l009: Solomon is the universal-rule comparison; not historical evidence for his armies' geography.
notes.manas-2010:p0784:b001:l020: Honor being covered interpreted protected rather than dishonored in the grateful address.
notes.manas-2010:p0784:b001:l025: Кембайла-: take/lead under guard, Yudakhin; not decomposed as кем+байла. Crimea deemed small while taken captive; azdaym retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0784:b001:l028: Кембайлап denotes taking captive/under guard, not finding inadequate. Corrected against Yudakhin.
notes.manas-2010:p0784:b001:l036: Wearing out many shirts is the literal experience/age idiom.
notes.manas-2010:p0784:b001:l038: Printed singular ал with multiple names translated contextually they; referent remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0785:b001:l008: Collective willingness to perish is explicit, not substituted with killing only enemies.
notes.manas-2010:p0785:b001:l024: One of seven days is death is a mortality formula, not a statistical prediction.
notes.manas-2010:p0785:b001:l031: Steel door/gateway metaphor retained; the following cannot be denies Shooruk's invulnerability.
notes.manas-2010:p0785:b001:l034: Negative conditional албаса retained as unless; syntax with the following condition is awkward and may be defective.
notes.manas-2010:p0785:b001:l042: Куда is marriage kin, distinct from кудай God. Livestock driven in the marriage arrangement, without inventing an exact bride-price.
notes.manas-2010:p0786:b001:l004: Түзөтүп read as leveling the fortress in destruction context, not repairing it; interpretation qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p0786:b001:l021: Manas explicitly orders companions to perish rather than flee; harsh discipline retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0786:b001:l025: Чогоол fierce/impetuous qualifies gunfire; not an unidentified weapon name.
notes.manas-2010:p0786:b001:l037: Threat to behead his own companions, including elders, is explicit.

excluded_source_ids.reason: Substantive expression кет кудай not reliably interpreted; verse preserved separately, excluded from English counts.

transcription_check.scope: All twenty PDF page images visually inspected,42display rows each,840total. All verse including split777:l004–005; no headings/prose. One lexical gap768:l019 excluded and preserved separately. Raw unchanged; no manuscript collation.

alignment_check.method: All840ordered Kyrgyz/draft pairs read in two420-row groups; unresolved768:l019 excluded after lexical checking. Dictionary corrections reread at source positions. Same-agent review only.
